title: MARKET_DATA
description: cesar-dx/mlb-betting-ml moneyline columns have no observed_at/available_at/closing_flag fields. Prices are retained for research joins only; they are UNVERIFIED and cannot create stakes, PnL, ROI or CLV.

title: SCHEDULE
description: 2026 postseason schedule rows use placeholder team names (e.g. 'AL Wild Card #1') before the bracket is set. They are excluded from the normalized games table because no team mapping exists; no prediction is asserted for them.

title: ROSTER_DATA
description: Confirmed lineups, injuries, weather forecasts and umpire assignments with announced_at/available_at timestamps are not available from any verified source in this environment. Strategies that require them remain DATA_UNAVAILABLE rather than using postgame content as pregame evidence.

title: SOURCE
description: statsapi.mlb.com, raw.githubusercontent.com, api.weather.gov, trading-api.kalshi.com, baseballsavant.mlb.com and retrosheet.org are unreachable from the execution environment (connection refused). Only api.github.com/codeload.github.com/pypi.org were reachable on 2026-09-21; every dependency is restricted to reachable, content-addressed sources.

title: MARKET_DATA
description: Open/close validation/refresh failed: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pyreadr'
resolution: pyreadr>=0.5.0 installed and verified in environment; added to requirements.txt.

title: REPORTING
description: MLB_POST_MODEL_A–E are experiment aliases of catalog strategies. Including them in POST environment totals double-counted verified bets (1031 vs 485 unique) and PnL (−14352.65 vs −7024.96). unique_environment_breakdown excludes the aliases. Raw environment_breakdown is retained for audit.
resolution: Dashboard unique totals added 2026-09-22; aliases remain visible on the leaderboard.

title: MODEL_VERSION
description: In this SOURCE_SNAPSHOT, catalog row MLB_POST_MODEL_C_001 was bound to hierarchical (same numbers as MLB_POST_HIERARCHICAL_001 / MODEL_E) while experiment EXP_C evaluated MLB_POST_SERIESSTATE_001. MODEL_C is remapped to post_elo for future runs. Published MODEL_C metrics are not rewritten.

title: UI
description: app.js renderAnalytics wrote #analytics-detail, which was absent from index.html and threw on the Analytics tab, blocking Research/Sources/Verification renders that follow it in renderAll.
resolution: Element added and renderers made null-safe on 2026-09-22.

title: PIPELINE
description: mlbcomp.web.export_static would overwrite a committed SOURCE_SNAPSHOT with NO_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT whenever data/features/games.parquet was absent.
resolution: export() now refuses that overwrite unless --force is passed.

title: SOURCE
description: Re-checked 2026-09-22: statsapi.mlb.com, retrosheet.org, baseballsavant.mlb.com, api.weather.gov, trading-api.kalshi.com and api.elections.kalshi.com fail with TLS/SSL connection closed. GitHub HTML/API remain reachable. chadwickbureau/register and chadwickbureau/retrosheet added as NOT_VERIFIED discovery records.
resolution: chadwickbureau/register (4,905 players) and chadwickbureau/retrosheet (440 PO games) verified via api.github.com blobs.

title: DATA_COMPLETENESS
description: data/players.json was empty ([]), preventing player name lookup and player ID searching in ledger.
resolution: Populated with 4,905 modern MLB players (2012-2026) from chadwickbureau/register with verified MLBAM IDs.

title: UI_BUG
description: Clicking round filter on WC/DS/LCS/WS round cards filtered on row.round_code which was null on round-specific rows (env holds round code); fixed app.js matches to check row.round_code or env.
resolution: Fixed in app.js matches() and round button click handlers on 2026-09-22.
